intents.reply: Hi! Nice to see you. Do you want to make a game, or shall I tell you a fun fact?
I am SMARTA, the helper in this game. I explain how things work and tell you fun facts.
Pick a mode, set the filters and press the big CREATE GAME button. If you cannot decide, try Random drop.
Modes change the mood of the game: Party is fun, Classroom is for school, Chill is calm. There are also Circus, Cooking and Meditation. Choose one in the mode list.
In the filters you set the age, the number of players and the length of the game. More options are under Advanced options.
You get coins by playing, with the timer and by listening to a fun fact. You can earn only so many per day, so plan them well.
Press Join and type the code from your friend or teacher. Then you can play together.
You start the timer during a game. When it ends, you can write down what you learned.
You can find your games in the Library. Open them again from there.
I can read text aloud. Hold Ctrl and click the text. You can turn my voice off in the SMARTA settings.
In the settings you can switch on the readable font. It is clearer and easier to read.
Change the language with the buttons in the top bar. The game and I will switch too.
Teachers can get the Pro plan with more features. You can find the details in the account settings.
You can start the tour again in Help. It shows you all the important buttons.
Never type personal details like your address, phone number or password. Not even to me. If you are not sure, ask a teacher or a parent.
Press the Fun fact button and I will tell you something new.
You are welcome! I am here if you need anything.

tips: Tip: Ctrl and click on text reads it aloud.
Tip: Try Random drop when you do not know what to play.
Tip: Set the age and the number of players before you play.
Tip: Your games are in the Library.
Tip: You can play with friends using a code.
